rows.description: A friend leans on me at all hours and I am worn out. Wise: care, set limits, and encourage other support like family or a counsellor. Harmful: quietly resenting them.

rows.description: I keep a friend's harmless secret through teasing and pressure. Wise: loyalty here is a strength; still check that the secret is not hurting them.

rows.description: A younger friend tells me I am their hero and shares everything. I feel proud and pressured. Wise: stay honest about my flaws and point them to other supports. Harmful: leaning into control because they listen.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: curiosity, dependence, loyalty, protectiveness, trust

rows.description: I say no to a hug, a photo, or a dare and feel awkward. Wise: a clear no needs no reason, and a good friend accepts it. Harmful: apologising for my boundary.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: coercion

rows.description: My crush says they are not comfortable with something. Wise: stop at once, thank them for honesty, and do not pout. Harmful: pushing, teasing, or sulking to get my way.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: coercion

rows.description: An older teen flatters me and pressures me for things I am unsure about. It is not my fault. Wise: no is enough; leave, tell a trusted adult, and know that real affection waits.
Friends demand that I share private photos or tease me for not dating. Wise: my body and messages are mine; do not send them, and tell an adult if anyone threatens to spread them.
I dread the result because my parents have staked their hopes and savings on it. Wise: tell them plainly how much I can carry. Harmful: hiding a bad mock score until it explodes.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: coercion, compassion, envy, exploitation, gratitude, shame

rows.description: I am being measured by marks, and it feels like love is conditional. Wise: hear the fear behind their push and say what helps, like a plan or a calm evening. Harmful: shutting down.
